name: android-cast-macos
description: High-performance, battery-optimized Android screen mirror & control for macOS over Wi-Fi with Apple Metal GPU and auto-unlock

scripts.setup: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && cp -n .env.example .env || true
scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile main.py config.py device.py engine.py build_app.py && bash -n launcher.sh cast.sh
